draft.shortGloss: to leave; to quit; to be spent
draft.emotion: hurried and final, turning your back to walk out the door
notes: Imperfective; the perfective is уйти. Do not confuse with выходить (to step out or exit briefly); уходить means leaving for good or going away.
Takes из or с (+ genitive) for the place or job you leave, and от (+ genitive) for the person you leave.

senses.definition: To go away from a place; to depart.

examples.translation: It is time for me to go home.
examples.emotion: reluctant to leave a pleasant evening, checking the watch

senses.definition: To leave a job, school, or relationship permanently.

examples.text: Он уходит с работы в следующем месяце.
examples.translation: He is leaving his job next month.

senses.definition: Of time, money, or effort: to be spent or used up (with на + accusative).

examples.text: Много времени уходит на эту работу.
examples.translation: A lot of time goes into this work.
examples.emotion: tired and overwhelmed by the amount of tasks
